new.brief: Creates a new event controller that will handle key events.
new.md: Creates a new event controller that will handle key events.

forward.brief: Forwards the current event of this `controller` to a `widget`.
forward.md:
Forwards the current event of this `controller` to a `widget`.

This function can only be used in handlers for the
[`EventControllerKey::key-pressed`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerKey#event:key-pressed),
[`EventControllerKey::key-released`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerKey#event:key-released)
or [`EventControllerKey::modifiers`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerKey#event:modifiers) signals.

get_group.brief: Gets the key group of the current event of this `controller`.
get_group.md:
Gets the key group of the current event of this `controller`.

See [`KeyEvent.get_layout()`](xref:gtk:Gdk.KeyEvent#method:get_layout).

get_im_context.brief: Gets the input method context of the key `controller`.
get_im_context.md: Gets the input method context of the key `controller`.

set_im_context.brief: Sets the input method context of the key `controller`.
set_im_context.md: Sets the input method context of the key `controller`.

im-update.brief: Emitted whenever the input method context filters away a keypress and prevents the `controller` receiving it.
im-update.md:
Emitted whenever the input method context filters away
a keypress and prevents the `controller` receiving it.

See [`EventControllerKey.set_im_context()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.EventControllerKey#method:set_im_context) and
[`IMContext.filter_keypress()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.IMContext#method:filter_keypress).

key-pressed.brief: Emitted whenever a key is pressed.
key-pressed.md: Emitted whenever a key is pressed.

key-released.brief: Emitted whenever a key is released.
key-released.md: Emitted whenever a key is released.

modifiers.brief: Emitted whenever the state of modifier keys and pointer buttons change.
modifiers.md: Emitted whenever the state of modifier keys and pointer buttons change.
